items.title: Mcbee interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2020
items.q: a musician that was a housemate of mine at SUNY Fredonia played on your record, Onaje Allan Gumbs.

ctx.x: Sure. Remember you, as a composer, you are the one that has exacted qualities of thought that find, you know, qualities of performances by those that you have chosen. So simply you can ask someone to, like I said before, when I play, when I’m soloing, please sustain the chords. Don’t get rhythmic, don’t get rhythmic because that might interfere with my rhythms when I’m soloing. So if you know, anything can be altered. During a recording things are constantly done, adjusted from time to time. You might want your…
Yeah. On a personal note I was happy to see that a musician that was a housemate of mine at SUNY Fredonia played on your record, Onaje Allan Gumbs.
